read.thesis: Europe supply-side reset via CBAM and TRQ from July 1 underpins restart of idled blast furnaces at Fos and Dabrowa; 1Q26 EBITDA/t rose to $131 but FCF was -$1.3bn on $1.5bn working-capital build.

utilisation.quote: Lower imports will lead to higher capacity utilization, restoring profitability and returns on capital to healthy, sustainable levels.

capex.quote: 2026 capex guidance remains unchanged at $4.5bn-$5.0bn and includes $1.7-$2.0bn of strategic capex on high return projects.

triggers.label: TRQ and CBAM reset European imports
triggers.quote: structurally resets the outlook for the European steel industry. Lower imports will lead to higher capacity utilization

triggers.label: Preparatory work to restart two idled blast furnaces
triggers.quote: preparatory work has begun to restart the two idled blast furnaces at Fos (France) and Dąbrowa Górnicza (Poland), subject to market conditions.

triggers.label: EBITDA/t $131 up $15 year-on-year
triggers.quote: 1Q 2026 EBITDA per tonne of $131/t increasing by $15/t year-on-year

triggers.label: Working capital outflow $1.5bn, FCF -$1.3bn
triggers.quote: A typical seasonal working capital investment of $1.5bn during the quarter led to a free cash outflow of $1.3bn

guidance.quote: 12M 2026 depreciation guidance remains unchanged at approximately $3.0 billion.
Liberia shipment guidance remains unchanged at >18Mt in 2026.
The potential incremental EBITDA impact of strategic capex projects (including completed M&A) is now $1.8bn

red_flags.label: Negative FCF and net debt up to $9.3bn
red_flags.quote: led to a free cash outflow of $1.3bn and an increase in net debt to $9.3bn
